safi-cedvel:1-3.t:
* I'rab:
(في دين) is attached to (يدخلون). (أفواجا) is an accusative ḥāl from the agent of يدخلون. (the fāʾ) is the connecting fāʾ of the apodosis. (بحمد) is attached to a ḥāl from the agent of سبّح, i.e. "being engaged in the praise of"..
Clause: «جاء نصر الله» is in the position of genitive, as muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «رأيت ... » is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause جاء نصر ...
And the clause: «يدخلون ... » is in the position of accusative, a ḥāl from الناس [Note: or a second direct object if the seeing is of the heart.].
And the clause: «سبّح ... » has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
And the clause: «استغفره ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause سبّح.
And the clause: «إنّه كان توابا ... » has no grammatical position; it is causal.
And the clause: «كان توّابا» is in the position of nominative, the khabar of إنّ.

* Rhetoric:
Al-istiʿāra al-makniyya (implicit metaphor): in His saying, the Exalted: «إِذا جاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ».
Here the decreed thing, namely the victory and the conquest, is likened to a living being walking, directed from eternity to its appointed time; so the occurrence is likened to coming, the thing likened to is omitted, and one of its characteristics, namely coming, is taken.

* Benefits:
- Knowledge raises its possessor:
On the authority of Ibn ʿAbbās, may Allah be pleased with them both, who said: ʿUmar, may Allah be pleased with him, used to admit me with the elders of Badr. Some of them said: Why does this youth enter with us? He said: He is one of those whom you know. He said: One day he called them and called me with them, then said: What do you say about the saying of Allah the Exalted (إِذا جاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ) to the end of the sūra? Some of them said: We were commanded to praise Allah and ask His forgiveness when we are given victory and a conquest is opened for us; and some were silent and said nothing. He said to me: Is that what you say, O Ibn ʿAbbās? I said: No. He said: Then what is it? I said: It is the term of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, which He informed him of: (إِذا جاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ) – that is the sign of your term – (فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُ إِنَّهُ كانَ تَوَّاباً). ʿUmar said: I know nothing of it except what you know.
Ibn ʿAbbās said: When this sūra was revealed, the Prophet ﷺ knew that his own death had been announced to him.
